certificate.method: regular Newton fan and exact torus Jacobian tests
certificate.description: A sequence of triangular polynomial substitutions, each fixing the origin with Jacobian determinant one, gives coordinates in which the exceptional images lie in the singular locus and the faces over the origin are nondegenerate. The nontrivial coordinate images of the exceptional divisors lie in the singular locus. Every maximal cone has lattice determinant one. The strict transform is smooth and transverse to the toric strata over the origin.
certificate.atlas_verification: Embedded normal crossings on the owned origin fibre
